name: Catch of the HEART!
source:
SERVE cheese burburs. SURVIVE dangerous women. SAVE the world. At the best undersea restaurant this side of the Steppe...

In an era long forgotten, your ancestors chose to uproot themselves, leaving everything behind for a new life in the ocean. Their pledge of undying devotion has been carried for generations; an act of pure love, and a promise to serve the ocean and all who reside within. 

Unfortunately, you're not a perfect guardian angel. In fact, you're actually a bit of a loser, but you're all the Steppe's got. So what better way to serve the ocean’s inhabitants, than by cooking them delicious burburs? 

[From [url=https://fishyink.itch.io/catch-of-the-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
享用奶酪毛边。生存危险的女性。拯救世界。在草原这边最好的海底餐厅……

在一个早已被遗忘的时代，你们的祖先选择背井离乡，抛下一切，在海洋中开始新的生活。他们的不朽奉献誓言代代相传。这是纯粹的爱的行为，也是服务海洋和海洋中所有生物的承诺。

不幸的是，你不是一个完美的守护天使。事实上，你确实有点失败，但你是草原的全部。那么，还有什么比为海洋居民烹饪美味的毛刺更好的方式呢？

[来自[url=https://fishyink.itch.io/catch-of-the-heart]itch.io[/url]]
